apps.name: Expense Manager
apps.shortDescription: Smart daily budget, income tracker, and visual expense manager with offline privacy.
apps.fullDescription: Expense Manager is an intuitive personal finance and daily expense tracker designed to help you regain complete clarity over your finances. Categorize income and expenses effortlessly, set monthly spending limits, and review your spending habits with clean visual charts. Works 100% offline with zero bank account linking required.
features: Quick 1-tap expense and income entry
Custom categories with color tags and icons
Monthly spending budgets with threshold notifications
Detailed category breakdown and monthly comparison charts
Complete offline data storage with optional CSV export
Biometric PIN / Fingerprint lock for financial privacy
permissions: Storage / Media (for backing up and exporting CSV financial reports)
Notifications (optional daily evening expense logging reminder)
apps.privacyPolicy: Expense Manager operates fully on-device. Your financial transactions, categories, and balances are never uploaded to any remote server.

faq.question: Does Expense Manager link to my bank account?
faq.answer: No. Expense Manager operates offline without asking for bank logins or credentials, ensuring 100% privacy.

faq.question: Can I export my records for tax filing or Excel?
faq.answer: Yes, you can export your entire transaction history to a CSV or PDF report at any time from the Settings screen.

apps.name: Color Notes & Quick Lists
apps.shortDescription: Clean, colorful notepad for checklists, memos, reminders, and daily journaling.
apps.fullDescription: Capture your thoughts, daily agendas, and shopping lists instantly with Color Notes. Featuring color-coded organization, rich markdown text editing, instant search, pinned favorites, and home screen widgets, it keeps your daily routine organized and effortless.
features: Color-coded notebook tabs and labels
Checklist mode with interactive strike-through items
Voice-to-text dictation support
Pin important notes to top of the grid
Automatic dark mode and custom font scaling
Trash bin recovery with 30-day restore guarantee
apps.privacyPolicy: All notes, checklists, and memos are stored securely in local device storage and remain strictly private.

faq.question: Are my notes backed up to the cloud?
faq.answer: You can create an encrypted local backup file or save it to your personal Google Drive account at any time.

apps.name: QR Utility - Scanner & Creator
apps.shortDescription: Lightning-fast QR & barcode scanner with custom code generator and history log.
apps.fullDescription: QR Utility provides ultra-fast code scanning for all 1D and 2D formats (QR, UPC, EAN, Code 39, Data Matrix). Generate custom QR codes for Wi-Fi credentials, contacts, website links, or text with personalized colors and logos. Includes an offline history log and batch scanning mode.
features: Instant camera detection with flashlight toggle for dark settings
Scan directly from gallery screenshots or images
Wi-Fi QR code 1-tap connection
Create QR codes for URLs, SMS, Contacts, WhatsApp, and Crypto
Continuous batch scan mode for inventory and retail
URL safety checks before opening external links in browser
permissions: Camera (required to scan QR and barcodes)
Storage (optional to read QR codes from device photo gallery)
apps.privacyPolicy: Camera feed is processed in real-time on your hardware. No images or camera streams are transmitted or saved.

faq.question: Does it support scanning barcodes on products?
faq.answer: Yes! It supports UPC-A, EAN-13, EAN-8, Code 128, and many more barcode formats for price checks and product lookup.

apps.name: Chess Master 3D - Offline Strategy
apps.shortDescription: Classic chess game with intelligent AI engine, puzzle tactics, and two-player mode.
apps.fullDescription: Whether you are learning chess fundamentals or mastering advanced opening lines, Chess Master 3D brings a tactile wooden board experience to your smartphone. Challenge 10 adaptive AI difficulty levels, solve over 500 tactical chess puzzles, or pass-and-play with a friend offline.
features: Realistic 3D and high-contrast 2D board perspectives
10 difficulty levels powered by an optimized Stockfish-derived engine
Hint and Undo move assistance for beginner learning
Daily endgame and checkmate puzzle challenges
PGN export to analyze matches in your favorite chess software
No internet connection required — play anytime on airplanes or commutes
apps.privacyPolicy: Offline game with zero personal telemetry. Game progress and scores are saved only on your device.

faq.question: Can I play offline without Wi-Fi?
faq.answer: Yes! The entire AI engine and puzzle database run 100% offline without any internet connection.

apps.name: Smart Alarm Clock & Sleep Sounds
apps.shortDescription: Gentle wake-up alarm with soothing nature sounds, math puzzles, and bedtime timer.
apps.fullDescription: Smart Alarm Clock helps you wake up feeling refreshed rather than startled. Choose from progressive volume wake-up tones, ambient white noise and rain sounds for sleep, and interactive morning brain puzzles to ensure you never accidentally sleep through your schedule.
features: Gradual sunrise volume increase over 1 to 10 minutes
Mission dismiss tasks: solve math, shake phone, or scan QR
Soothing bedtime ambient sound machine (rain, waves, campfire, forest)
Multiple recurring alarms with custom labels and vibration patterns
Bedtime reminder with wind-down screen dimmer
permissions: Alarm & Reminders (USE_EXACT_ALARM for precision wake-up timing)
Notifications (active alarm status in notification shade)
apps.privacyPolicy: Alarm times, sound preferences, and sleep logs remain on your local phone storage.

faq.question: Will the alarm ring if my phone is on silent mode?
faq.answer: Yes, alarms use the dedicated Android Alarm stream to ensure sound rings even when silent or Do Not Disturb is active.

apps.name: Brick Storm - Retro Ball Breaker
apps.shortDescription: Addictive brick breaker arcade with physics-based bounces and power-ups.
apps.fullDescription: Aim, shoot, and watch chains of balls clear geometric brick obstacles in Brick Storm. Featuring hundreds of satisfying stages, lasers, split-balls, bomb explosions, and vibrant retro synthwave visuals.
features: Realistic ball physics and collision dynamics
Over 300 unique handcrafted challenge levels
Unlockable ball skins and glowing visual effects
Power-up boosters including missile strikes and horizontal lasers
Playable with one finger in vertical portrait mode
apps.privacyPolicy: Offline casual game. No personal data collected.

faq.question: Is internet connection required to play?
faq.answer: No, all 300+ levels are unlocked and playable offline.

apps.name: Habit Forge - Daily Routine Tracker
apps.shortDescription: Build enduring positive habits, track daily streaks, and visualize personal growth.
apps.fullDescription: Habit Forge transforms goal setting into a rewarding daily habit loop. Create morning and evening routines, track milestone streaks, and build momentum with flexible schedules and motivating streak heatmaps.
features: Flexible habit scheduling (daily, specific weekdays, or times per week)
GitHub-style annual streak heatmap visualization
Custom reminder notifications tailored to each routine
Detailed success rate statistics and completion percentages
apps.privacyPolicy: Habit records and streak milestones are stored locally on your device.

apps.name: Unit & Currency Converter Pro
apps.shortDescription: Offline unit converter covering 30+ measurement categories and global currencies.
apps.fullDescription: An indispensable tool for students, engineers, travelers, and home chefs. Converts length, weight, area, volume, temperature, pressure, speed, data storage, and global currency exchange rates with instant real-time typing results.
features: Instant conversion as you type across 30+ physical units
Offline calculation engine with cached currency rates
Built-in mini scientific calculator
Clean numeric keypad designed for quick one-handed use
permissions: Network (optional to update daily international currency exchange rates)
apps.privacyPolicy: No personal data collected or stored.

# Privacy Policy
**KHB Private Limited (KAMBARIYA-HB ENTERPRISE PRIVATE LIMITED)**
*Last updated: September 1, 2026*

This Privacy Policy explains how KHB Private Limited ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and discloses information about you when you use our mobile applications, games, and website services.

### 1. Information We Collect
We believe in minimal data collection. Most of our utility apps and casual games function entirely on-device without requiring an account.
- **Device & Technical Information:** Hardware model, operating system version, anonymous device identifiers, and general diagnostic crash logs.
- **Support & Inquiries:** When you contact us directly via email or our support forms, we receive your name, email address, and message contents.

### 2. Information We Do Not Collect
- We do NOT collect personal financial account data, government ID numbers, or sensitive personal documents.
- We do NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

### 3. Third-Party Services & Advertising
Some of our free applications display advertisements provided by Google AdMob. These services may collect pseudonymous identifiers (e.g., Google Advertising ID) subject to their respective privacy policies:
- **Google Play Services:** https://policies.google.com/privacy
- **Google AdMob:** https://support.google.com/admob/answer/6128543

### 4. Children's Privacy
Our applications comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and Google Play Families Policy. Apps targeted toward general audiences or families do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent.

### 5. Data Security
We implement industry-standard security protocols to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

### 6. User Rights & Contact
You have the right to inquire about any data we retain or request its deletion. For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
**Email:** support@khbenterprise.com  
**Legal Entity:** KAMBARIYA-HB ENTERPRISE PRIVATE LIMITED

faqs.q: How do I backup or restore data in your utility apps?

Since we prioritize privacy and do not store your data on external clouds, your backups reside securely on your device storage or personal Google Drive.

faqs.q: Are your apps and casual games free to use?

faqs.q: Do your apps require an active internet connection?
faqs.a: Our core productivity tools, calculators, and casual games operate 100% offline. Network permissions are only utilized when refreshing external currency rates, checking for updates, or loading Google Play advertisements.

faqs.q: How can I report a bug or crash?
